name: Content Brief
description: Creates writer-ready content briefs with audience definition, content angle, detailed outline, keyword targets, source suggestions, and tone guidance. Use when the user needs to brief a writer, plan a content piece before drafting, or create an assignment document for content creation. Do NOT use for editorial calendars (use `editorial-calendar`), content audits (use `content-audit`), or writing the actual content piece (use `blog-post-writing`).
